decision_scope: visual artifact review only; no Q-N/Q-E/precision/convergence/production/global-credit claim
lifecycle_rule: transient_missing_frame_count, maximum_missing_particles_per_frame, and final UID status are separate fields; visual appearance never establishes UID identity or survival.
receipt_rule: Only Root715 actual completed/0 receipts and their complete reports are selected; the third Root715 reservation failure is preserved as excluded.
renderer_title_rule: Stale pending/precision title text is preserved as a limitation and never upgraded to a numerical conclusion.
scope_rule: Actual converter/manifest scope, Root715 source binding, owner-file/source-declared scope, and source-plan scope remain separate.
